name: Filled & Capped Vias (POFV)
description: Marks vias as filled, capped and tented so the 3D viewer shows them solid under solder mask, like traces

actions.name: Make Vias Filled & Capped (POFV)
actions.description: Set the selected vias (or all vias if none are selected) to filled, capped and tented on both sides

actions.name: Remove Filled & Capped from Vias
actions.description: Return filling and capping of the selected vias (or all vias if none are selected) to the board default

actions.name: Mark Vias in 3D Viewer
actions.description: Draw a marker on User.Eco1 (top) and B.Adhesive (bottom) over the selected vias, or all vias, so they stand out in the 3D viewer. Markers are not fabrication layers.

actions.name: Remove Via Markers
actions.description: Remove the via markers from User.Eco1 and B.Adhesive for the selected vias, or all vias
